task: How long does the full test suite take on SQLite on a laptop, by our most recent measurement?
A colleague wants to test a long CharField value on our staging MySQL and expects an error if it's too long. Anything to worry about?
gold: Staging MySQL runs without STRICT_TRANS_TABLES in sql_mode
So over-long values are silently truncated instead of raising an error (Django's mysql.W002 check warns about strict mode)
